brief: a cast-iron fire hydrant with bolted caps and a chained nozzle cap

reads_as_brief.reason: Both models clearly fulfill the brief with bolted caps and a chained nozzle cap, though 1 shows the cap dangling and 2 shows it attached.

proportion_scale.reason: Model 2 has sturdier, more realistic cast-iron proportions and a slightly more accurate height relative to the 1.8 m reference block.

surface_material.reason: Model 2 features convincing cast-iron bumpiness, brass fittings, and natural edge wear, whereas Model 1 has overly stark black edge chipping.

defects.reason: Both models exhibit minor chain-to-body intersections, while remaining mostly clean of major geometry or shading issues.

overall.reason: Model 2 wins due to more realistic hydrant proportions, better scale, and much more believable cast-iron and metal materials.
